title: A Sigil for the Hollow Revisited
premise: Silas Thackeray makes a living in the Hollow, a valley where magic cannot follow, by stealing memories and selling them to those who want to forget. When the border wards collapse on the night the stars vanish, the outside world's exiled mages pour in hunting the valley's one secret: a door that can restore what the Hollow erased. Silas learns their own stolen memories hold the key—and that they were the one who sealed it years ago, at a terrible cost they chose to forget. To escape a country being rewritten around them, Silas must reclaim that memory, face the justice of those they wronged, and decide whether power worth having is power worth surrendering.
about_author: Felix Okafor is a former archivist who writes fantasy about the things institutions prefer to lose. He lives near a river he refuses to name, and claims his best ideas arrive during blackouts.

chapters.title: The Weight of Forgotten Things
chapters.summary: Silas works a routine job extracting a widow's grief, establishing the Hollow's memory-trade economy and its magicless rules. That night, the stars go out one by one while Silas watches from a rooftop. POV: Silas. Emotional beat: uneasy wonder curdling into dread—the first crack in a life built on controlled forgetting.

chapters.title: Wards Like Broken Teeth
chapters.summary: The border wards shatter at dawn, and refugees—exiled mages calling themselves the Reckoning—flood the valley demanding the door to the old country. Silas's fence, Marrow, reveals clients have been asking for memories of 'the sealing.' POV: Silas. Emotional beat: hunted invisibility; the safety of smallness dies.

chapters.title: What the Widow Kept
chapters.summary: Silas discovers a splinter of their own memory inside the widow's extraction—a fragment they don't remember selling. It shows hands drawing a sigil on a stone door. POV: Silas, with interludes of the fragment itself. Emotional beat: vertigo of self-estrangement; Silas realizes they've been robbed by themselves.

chapters.title: The Reckoning Arrives
chapters.summary: Reckoning commander Vess Adair occupies the town square, offering clemency to informants and hanging a collaborator as example. She names Silas Thackeray specifically: the thief who stole the door's key-memory. POV: alternating Silas and Vess. Emotional beat: fear sharpening into defiance; justice arrives wearing a uniform.

chapters.title: Marrow's Price
chapters.summary: Silas bargains with Marrow for safe passage toward the door, paying with memories of their mother. Marrow confesses he sold Silas's location to Vess hours ago. POV: Silas. Emotional beat: betrayal and grief compounding; every relationship in the Hollow was already a transaction.

chapters.title: Road Through the Unmapped
chapters.summary: Fleeing with the widow Odile—whose grief-splinter makes her an unlikely ally—Silas crosses country where erased magic is leaking back in, warping land and memory alike. They are ambushed; Odile takes a wound meant for Silas. POV: Silas. Emotional bond deepens into chosen loyalty. Emotional beat: guilt transforming into responsibility.

chapters.title: The Door Remembers
chapters.summary: At the buried door, Silas recovers the full sealing memory: years ago they stole the country's collective memory of a massacre to spare the survivors—and locked it away, erasing the victims' claim to justice. Vess arrives not to destroy the door but to open it and weaponize what's inside. POV: Silas and Vess converging. Emotional beat: horror at one's own past power; the cost of mercy without consent.

chapters.title: A Sigil Reversed
chapters.summary: Climax begins: Silas fights Vess among the wards' ruins, using stolen memories as weapons—giving attackers memories they never earned, unmaking their convictions mid-battle. Odile, wounded, holds the sigil-line steady. POV: Silas. Emotional beat: fury and clarity; power wielded at last for someone other than oneself.

chapters.title: The Country That No Longer Exists
chapters.summary: Silas opens the door and releases the sealed massacre-memory back to the world—justice restored at the price of everyone's comfortable forgetting, including their own absolution. Vess, confronted with what her Reckoning would become, stands down rather than repeat the crime. POV: Silas. Emotional beat: devastating release; truth as both wound and cure.

chapters.title: Stars, Returning
chapters.summary: Weeks later, the stars return over a valley learning to live with everything it once erased. Silas, no longer a thief but not yet forgiven, stays—not hidden now, but accountable—teaching Odile the trade so memory is given, not taken. POV: Silas. Emotional beat: quiet, hard-won peace; justice outside the law means answering to people, forever.
